I posted the ticket list in #strategic-pod as a reply to your message. I found four Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source. Two are open questions:

1. #8841 (PD-8841 in one digest). The sources conflict on status and site. The Jul 1 pod message says Gideon closed it, but the May 4 and Sep 30 digests describe it as open, at Allentown and Newark respectively. Please confirm with support before it goes in the steering pack.
2. PD-4418, the Carrier_Dwell_Summary timestamp export issue (Sep 15 digest). The digest says "the account Nadia runs" without naming it, so the parent attribution is my inference.
3. INC-4821, the Hartford gate kiosk outage from Aug 3 (#inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon's 11:08 AM update).
4. VT-55120, the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage (#inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon's Oct 14 post).

The Aug 3 digest has no ticket numbers. I could not open any ticket itself because the accounts/ ticket folders in the share are empty.
